definition: the county levy on the house, and the ladder of ways out of it

settled:
It runs for as long as we own the house, and the assessment comes out of a method I cannot see into, with an appeal shaped to discourage me.

It is the clearest example I have of something that feels compulsory and is not.

Four ways out, in order of what they cost. Pay it, which is what I do. Use the homestead exemption or an age-based deferral when I qualify. Take a smaller house. Move counties.

None of them is urgent where we are now. The last two would cost me the children's schooling, the people here and the garden, which is much more than the tax is.

title: The Property Tax I Keep Paying
